title: WebSocket Hybrid API Server
description: Build a hybrid API server combining REST endpoints for data operations with WebSocket for real-time updates, plus hybrid mode statistics.

steps.title: Health check endpoint
steps.description: Create a GET /health endpoint that returns JSON with status ok.

steps.title: REST data creation
steps.description: Create a POST /data endpoint that accepts JSON payload and stores it, returning 201.
hints: Accept JSON body with any data fields
Assign a unique id to each stored item

steps.title: REST data retrieval
steps.description: Add a GET /data/:id endpoint that retrieves a stored data item by id.
hints: Find the item by id in the data store

steps.title: WebSocket real-time updates
steps.description: Add a WS /ws endpoint that broadcasts real-time data updates to all connected clients.
hints: Use express-ws or similar WebSocket library
Track connected clients in a Set
On new POST /data, broadcast to all WebSocket clients

steps.title: Hybrid mode statistics
steps.description: Add a GET /stats endpoint that returns hybrid mode statistics including REST and WebSocket counts.
hints: Track REST request count and WebSocket connection count
Return stats like totalDataItems, wsConnections, and hybridMode status
Increment counters in each route handler
